title: Site-specific arrangement and structure determination of minor groove binding molecules in self-assembled three-dimensional DNA crystals
authors: Chad R. Simmons; Alex Buchberger; Skylar J.W. Henry; Alexandra Novacek; Nour Eddine Fahmi; Tara MacCulloch; Nicholas Stephanopoulos; Hao Yan
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用自组装DNA晶体通过X射线晶体学解析小沟结合分子的位点特异性排列与结构，虽涉及蛋白质-DNA互作体系中的DNA-小分子结合，但对象非TF-DNA且方法为晶体学而非AI或物理模拟，仅对互作结构解析有参考价值。
abstract: The structural analysis of guest molecules in rationally designed and self-assembling DNA crystals has proven elusive since its conception. Oligonucleotide frameworks provide an especially attractive route towards studying DNA-binding molecules by using three-dimensional lattices with defined sequence and structure. In this work, we site-specifically position a suite of minor groove binding molecules, and solve their structures via x-ray crystallography, as a proof-of-principle towards scaffolding larger guest species. Two crystal motifs were used to precisely immobilize the molecules DAPI, Hoechst, and netropsin at defined positions in the lattice, allowing us to control occupancy within the crystal. We also solved the structure of a three-ring imidazole-pyrrole-pyrrole polyamide molecule, which sequence-specifically packs in an anti-parallel dimeric arrangement within the minor groove. Finally, we engineered a crystal designed to position both netropsin and the polyamide at two distinct locations within the same lattice. Our work elucidates the design principles for the spatial arrangement of functional guests within lattices and opens new potential opportunities for the use of DNA crystals to display and structurally characterize small molecules, peptides, and ultimately proteins of unknown structure.
abstract_zh: 理性设计和自组装DNA晶体中客体分子的结构分析自其概念提出以来一直难以实现。寡核苷酸框架通过具有明确序列和结构的三维晶格，为研究DNA结合分子提供了一条特别有吸引力的途径。在本工作中，我们位点特异性地定位了一系列小沟结合分子，并通过X射线晶体学解析其结构，作为支架更大客体物种的原理验证。我们使用了两种晶体基序，将DAPI、Hoechst和netropsin分子精确固定在晶格中的特定位置，从而能够控制晶体内的占据率。我们还解析了一个三环咪唑-吡咯-吡咯多酰胺分子的结构，该分子在小沟内以反平行二聚体排列方式序列特异性地堆积。最后，我们设计了一种晶体，旨在将netropsin和多酰胺同时定位于同一晶格中的两个不同位置。我们的工作阐明了晶格内功能客体空间排布的设计原理，并为利用DNA晶体展示和结构表征小分子、肽段以及最终未知结构的蛋白质开辟了新的潜在机遇。
